shortDescription: The Tampa Bay Rays option in Polymarket’s Tampa Bay Rays vs. Texas Rangers market surged from 58.5% an hour ago to 80.5%, a 22-point swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects a sharp fluctuation in the prediction market and may be affected by breaking news.
